transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. I'm here to help you. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with really severe mood swings over the past year. Sometimes I feel extremely high, energetic, and easily irritated, but then I'll swing into feeling deeply depressed and empty. I just can't seem to find a middle ground anymore.
During those times when your mood is extremely high or low, have you ever experienced things that others couldn't see or hear, or held beliefs that others found strange or untrue?
No, I have never experienced seeing or hearing things that others couldn't. I've also never held any beliefs that other people found strange or unusual.

During those high-energy periods, have you ever been so energized or out of control that you required hospitalization, or did those periods significantly interfere with your ability to work or maintain your daily responsibilities?

No, I don't think I've ever been hospitalized for those high-energy periods. I'm also not really sure if they interfered with my life to that extreme of a degree, though they definitely made things feel a bit chaotic.

I have included Bipolar I and II as primary considerations, and Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type) as a differential to be ruled out pending further assessment of potential psychotic symptoms.
